text2activity_extraction_model.title: MUM-T attack operation under EW

source_units.planned_content: The tank company prepares the TDSS and drones 1-3, checks normal communication and situational awareness (SA), deploys the drones for surveillance, and shares the company SA summary.
Drone 1 detects an enemy observation post and an FPV threat with an estimated arrival time of about 43 s; the company commander orders a detour and a dispersed maneuver.

Electronic-warfare jamming causes persistent packet loss and heartbeat loss, driving the link from normal to limited to disconnected; minimum SA and an emergency broadcast are maintained, platoon 2 evades after drone 3's ATGM alert, and losing drone 1 reduces the available drones from three to two.
The links and bandwidth of drones 2 and 3 recover in stages, SA is resynchronized, communication returns to normal, and the company reports and resumes the attack to secure the objective.

scenarios.label: MUM-T attack operation under EW
scenarios.summary: The tank company performs the attack maneuver using reconnaissance drones and the TDSS, maintains survivability-focused functions even during electronic warfare jamming, and then recovers communication and secures the objective.

episodes.label: E1 Preparation under normal comms
episodes.summary: Performs TDSS diagnostics, drone launch, SA sharing, and attack maneuver based on normal communication.

episodes.label: E2 Observation post and FPV threat
episodes.summary: The drones and the TDSS detect the enemy observation post and the FPV threat, and the company commander orders bypass and dispersed maneuver.

episodes.label: E3 EW jamming and comms degradation
episodes.summary: Due to jamming, the communication state transitions from normal to limited and from limited to blackout, and the TDSS and drones maintain survivability-focused functions.

episodes.label: E4 Comms recovery and attack resumption
episodes.summary: As the intermittent links stabilize, communication recovers from blackout to limited and from limited to normal, and the company resumes the attack on the objective.
